__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes ragtech-supervise (:4471/metrics)

description: Ragtech Supervise UPS telemetry from the ragtech_* Prometheus exporter (port 4471). Filter by instance and device_name.

panels.description: USB/API connection from ragtech_ups_status. This is not on-battery — see Power source.
panels.title: Connection

panels.description: Battery charge percentage from ragtech_ups_battery_charge_percent.
panels.title: Battery

panels.description: Load percent from ragtech_ups_load_percent (Supervise pOutput, with V×I fallback).
panels.title: Load

panels.description: UPS internal temperature from ragtech_ups_temperature_celsius.
panels.title: Temperature

panels.description: Input voltage from ragtech_ups_input_voltage_volts.
panels.title: Input voltage

panels.description: Output voltage from ragtech_ups_output_voltage_volts.
panels.title: Output voltage

panels.description: Apparent output power (vOutput × iOutput), not Supervise pOutput.
panels.title: Output power

panels.description: Output current from ragtech_ups_output_current_amps.
panels.title: Output current

panels.description: 1 = running on battery (ragtech_ups_on_battery). 0 = mains.
panels.title: Power source

panels.description: 1 = mains missing (ragtech_ups_input_missing).
panels.title: Mains input

panels.description: 1 = Supervise reports low battery (ragtech_ups_battery_low).
panels.title: Battery low

panels.description: Latest reading per UPS. Status is USB/API connected. On battery / mains missing / batt low come from Supervise status flags. Load is percent. Power is V×I watts. LED columns are 0–255 PWM.
panels.title: Current values

panels.description: Mains input vs UPS output voltage.
panels.title: Voltage

panels.description: Apparent output power (V×I watts) and current (amps). Current uses the right Y axis.
panels.title: Output power and current

panels.description: Output frequency from ragtech_ups_output_frequency_hertz.
panels.title: Output frequency

panels.description: Load percent. Supervise pOutput is already 0–100; exporter also uses V×I / nominal when that is larger.
panels.title: Load

panels.description: Internal temperature from ragtech_ups_temperature_celsius.
panels.title: Temperature

panels.description: Battery charge from ragtech_ups_battery_charge_percent.
panels.title: Battery charge

panels.description: Battery voltage from ragtech_ups_battery_voltage_volts.
panels.title: Battery voltage

panels.description: USB connected, on battery, mains missing, and low-battery flags over time.
panels.title: Operating state

panels.description: Front-panel RGB PWM (0-255). Values are shown as on when > 0.
panels.title: LED timeline

panels.description: Duration of the last UPS collector scrape (ragtech_collector_scrape_duration_seconds). The collector times out after 15s.
panels.title: Scrape duration

panels.description: Scrape errors reported on the last collector pass. The exporter emits 1 with an error_type label (system_status, list_devices, device_status) when that step fails, and omits the series on success. Treat this as a current-error flag, not a monotonically increasing counter.
panels.title: Scrape errors

panels.description: Exporter process RSS (ragtech_process_resident_memory_bytes) from the namespaced process collector.
panels.title: Exporter memory

panels.description: Exporter CPU usage from ragtech_process_cpu_seconds_total. 1.0 = one full core.
panels.title: Exporter CPU

panels.description: Open vs max file descriptors from ragtech_process_open_fds and ragtech_process_max_fds.
panels.title: Exporter file descriptors

panels.description: Supervise API start time is exported as ragtech_system_uptime_milliseconds (milliseconds since epoch). Exporter process start is ragtech_process_start_time_seconds. Both are shown as elapsed uptime.
panels.title: Uptime

title: Ragtech Supervise
